description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the LocalizationService in the OrangeHRM system. It tests various functionalities including date formats, language support, language exporting, XLIFF processing, error handling, and validation of language strings within the LocalizationService.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing various methods and functionalities of the LocalizationService in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture, initializes the LocalizationService instance, and populates test data from a configuration fixture.

methods.name: testGetLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Tests fetching of localization date formats, mocking the DateTimeHelperService to use a fixed 'now' date.

methods.name: testGetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Tests retrieval of supported languages, mocking getLanguagesArray method.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests searching for languages via DAO, mocking searchLanguages method.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language array including mapping language entities to label/id pairs.

methods.name: testGenerateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Tests generation of language key string based on language ID and string ID.

methods.name: testExportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language groups for language export.

methods.name: testGetXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Tests generating XLIFF XML sources for different language IDs, parsing the output XML.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForInvalidSyntaxTest
methods.description: Creates a mock of LocalizationService returning a specific error object for invalid syntax.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithInvalidSyntaxString
methods.description: Tests validation of a target string with invalid syntax, expecting an I18NError for syntax.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForValidateLangStringTesting
methods.description: Creates a mock of LocalizationService with specific language string and error setup for validation testing.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholders
methods.description: Tests validation of a string without placeholders, expecting null.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholdersError
methods.description: Tests validation for placeholder mismatch error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholders
methods.description: Tests proper validation with matching placeholders.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholdersInDifferentOrder
methods.description: Checks that placeholders in different order are considered valid if they match.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPlaceholders
methods.description: Checks detection of placeholder mismatch.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPluralString
methods.description: Validates plural syntax with matching categories.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralCategories
methods.description: Detects mismatch in categories within plural syntax.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutOtherPluralCategory
methods.description: Detects invalid plural syntax missing 'other' category, expecting an error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects invalid syntax missing variable in plural string, expecting an error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects mismatch in plural variable between source and target strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithSelectVariable
methods.description: Validates correct select syntax.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectOtherCategory
methods.description: Detects missing 'other' category in select syntax, expecting an error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects missing variable in select syntax, expecting an error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects mismatch in select variable, expects an error.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Fetches an I18NError object by name, expecting correct retrieval.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorWithInvalidErrorName
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if an invalid error name is requested.

methods.name: testLanguageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if the language has import errors based on error count.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Clears import errors for specific language strings; this test assumes a real repository and environment.

methods.name: getBase64AttachmentForTestingProcessXliff
methods.description: Helper to create a Base64Attachment object with provided XLIFF content.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyContent
methods.description: Tests processing an empty XLIFF file, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidContent
methods.description: Tests processing an invalid XLIFF XML, expecting validation failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidVersion
methods.description: Tests XML with invalid version attribute, expecting failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Tests missing version attribute, expecting failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingSourceLanguage
methods.description: Tests missing srcLang attribute, expecting failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Tests missing trgLang attribute, expecting failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidTargetLanguageForLanguageId
methods.description: Tests target language mismatch with language ID, expecting failure.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyTargetString
methods.description: Processes XLIFF with empty target strings, expecting skipped entries.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithValidAndInvalidTargetStrings
methods.description: Processes mixed valid and invalid target strings, expecting validation errors.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidLangStrings
methods.description: Processes XLIFF with invalid language strings inside, expecting multiple errors.
